reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: OWN-02 separates caller-owned xbuffer descriptors from their ecalloc data; cmdbuf itself is a fixed 2048-byte image array, with separate heap completion/history objects.
owner_creation.invariant: A descriptor copy must not duplicate allocation ownership.
limitations: Static command bytes are not an expandable heap buffer.

aliases_escapes.analysis: OWN-02 exports xbuffer data addresses and accepts a raw add_data source across repeated growth calls. An overlapping source can become stale after old data is freed.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A source borrow must survive every destination growth.
limitations: No safe slice contract prevents overlapping source and destination.

callback_targets.analysis: OWN-02 uses direct ecalloc/memcpy/free calls for growth; command insertion directly invokes repaint and cursor movement after editing, without a retained buffer callback.
callback_targets.invariant: Callee entry must not replace an actively borrowed owner.
limitations: Direct dispatch does not provide an exclusive editing token.

invalidation.analysis: OWN-02 growth retires the old xbuffer address, while cmd_reset only rewrites static command bytes and cursor state. These are different kinds of alias invalidation.
invalidation.invariant: Address lifetime and text validity require separate reasoning.
limitations: A stable cmdbuf address does not preserve earlier text.

mutation_commit.analysis: OWN-02 changes size before overflow checking and replacement allocation; xbuf_set resets destination length before copying. These updates are not a failure-preserving staged byte transaction.
mutation_commit.invariant: Capacity metadata must agree with the live allocation.
limitations: No new runtime failure is claimed from this ordering alone.

release_pair.analysis: OWN-02 pairs data allocation with xbuf_deinit free/reset and frees old data during growth. The static cmdbuf array has no allocator release; completion strings have separate owners.
release_pair.invariant: Only heap xbuffer data may take the free counterpart.
limitations: A copied descriptor cannot independently deinitialize shared data.

error_cleanup.analysis: OWN-02 reserve hooks and overflow branches call fatal allocation handling rather than return a rollback object; command insertion instead rejects a full static array before shifting bytes.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failure recovery must identify which updates already occurred.
limitations: The bounded editor rejection does not approve xbuffer growth cleanup.

signals_handoff.analysis: OWN-02 temporary insert_mode changes and raw data growth have no encoded exclusive-owner handoff. M0-MEM-001 remains open; these sources do not establish a handler-to-editor mutation route.
signals_handoff.invariant: Borrowed bytes require ordinary serialized owner access.
limitations: Asynchronous editing is a precondition concern, not a reproduced event.
